comment: Group protocol v2 state machine vectors. Generated by server/src/gv2/stateMachine.test.ts (GV2_WRITE_VECTORS=1). `accepted` is one log in order; a `rejected` entry must be refused with `code` by the state after the first `afterAccepted` accepted entries.

accepted.name: owner invites bob (again), carol and dave
admin sets the title and removes a member
alice, now a MEMBER, revokes the invite she made
a change of exactly MAX_CHANGE_ACTIONS actions
owner transfers ownership to bob and leaves
the last member, the owner, leaves — the group ends

rejected.name: CREATE at a revision other than 0
CREATE followed by something other than INVITE
CREATE under a small-order member key with a universal forgery
ACCEPT signed by a key that is not the invite key
ACCEPT with an invite signature made for another invitee
ACCEPT by someone who was not invited
DECLINE signed by a key that is not the invite key
ACCEPT with the key of an earlier, declined invite
REMOVE on oneself (LEAVE is the way out)
REMOVE of someone who is not a member
a member payload without CREATE or ACCEPT
MEMBER revokes an invite made by someone else
revoking an invite that does not exist
LEAVE that is not the last action
acting as owner after handing ownership over in the same entry
any entry after the group ended
